biological.citation: Pip5k1c expression in osteocytes regulates bone remodeling in mice (PMID: 38495744)
biological.summary: Pip5k1c deletion in osteocytes (via Dmp1-Cre) causes low bone mass, reduced type 1 collagen, increased sclerostin expression, impaired focal adhesion proteins, and promoted apoptosis. Loss of Pip5k1c reduces osteoblast and bone formation rate while affecting osteoclast activities.

biological.citation: De novo missense variants in phosphatidylinositol kinase PIP5KIγ underlie a neurodevelopmental syndrome associated with altered phosphoinositide signaling (PMID: 37451268)
biological.summary: Three de novo heterozygous missense variants in PIP5K1C identified in nine unrelated children with intellectual disability, developmental delay, microcephaly, and seizures. Variants increase endosomal PI(4,5)P2 pool, causing ectopic filamentous actin recruitment at early endosomes and dysfunction in endosomal trafficking. Zebrafish model recapitulates forebrain and craniofacial defects.

biological.citation: PIP5K1C phosphoinositide kinase deficiency distinguishes PIKFYVE-dependent cancer cells from non-malignant cells (PMID: 36803256)
biological.summary: PIP5K1C deficiency in cancer cells confers sensitivity to PIKFYVE inhibitor WX8. PIP5K1C catalyzes conversion of PtdIns4P to PtdIns(4,5)P2 via one of two independent pathways; low PIP5K1C forces cancer cells to depend on PIKFYVE-PIP4K2C pathway. Inhibition of PIP5K1C in resistant cells increases WX8 sensitivity; overexpression increases resistance.

biological.citation: Novel genetic variants of PIP5K1C and MVB12B of the endosome-related pathway predict cutaneous melanoma-specific survival (PMID: 33163277)
biological.summary: SNP PIP5K1C rs11666894 A>C associated with cutaneous melanoma disease-specific survival (adjusted HR=1.47, 95% CI=1.15-1.89). eQTL analysis shows rs11666894 associated with PIP5K1C mRNA expression in lymphoblastoid cell lines from 373 European descendants (P<0.0001).
biological.sample_size: Discovery: 858 CM patients (95 deaths); Replication: 409 CM patients (48 deaths); eQTL: 373 individuals

biological.citation: Genetic Association and Expression Analyses of the Phosphatidylinositol-4-Phosphate 5-Kinase (PIP5K1C) Gene in Alcohol Use Disorder-Relevance for Pain Signaling and Alcohol Use (PMID: 29667742)
biological.summary: Eight SNPs in PIP5K1C significantly associated with alcohol use disorder in African ancestry group (rs4807493, rs10405681, rs2074957, rs10432303, rs8109485, rs1476592, rs10419980, rs4432372; p<0.05 after correction). In humanized transgenic mice with OPRM1 polymorphism, acute alcohol exposure significantly upregulated PIP5K1C expression in thalamus and basolateral amygdala.
biological.sample_size: Discovery: 427 AA cases, 137 controls; 488 EA cases, 324 controls; Replication: N=3,801; Mouse model
biological.significance: p<0.05 (discovery, AA group); p<0.05 thalamus, p<0.01 BLA (mouse)

biological.citation: Pip5k1c Loss in Chondrocytes Causes Spontaneous Osteoarthritic Lesions in Aged Mice (PMID: 37008048)
biological.summary: Inducible deletion of Pip5k1c in aggrecan-expressing chondrocytes causes spontaneous OA-like lesions in aged (15-month) but not adult (7-month) mice. Pip5k1c loss promotes ECM degradation, chondrocyte hypertrophy and apoptosis, inhibits proliferation, and dramatically downregulates focal adhesion proteins (integrin β1, talin, vinculin), impairing chondrocyte adhesion and spreading.

biological.citation: Development of a High-Throughput Screening Assay to Identify Inhibitors of the Lipid Kinase PIP5K1C (PMID: 25534829)
biological.summary: Developed microfluidic mobility shift assay for PIP5K1C inhibitor screening using fluorescently labeled PI(4)P substrate and recombinant human PIP5K1C. Assay shows high reproducibility (z'>0.7), ATP Km=15 µM. Screen of ~4700 compounds identified potent inhibitors including UNC3230, which reduces nociceptive sensitization in chronic pain models.

biological.citation: Loss of phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 5-kinase type-1 gamma (Pip5k1c) in mesenchymal stem cells leads to osteopenia by impairing bone remodeling (PMID: 35090892)
biological.summary: Pip5k1c deletion in mesenchymal stem cells (Prx1-Cre) causes osteopenia in adult mice by decreasing osteoblast formation and osteoid/mineral deposition. Pip5k1c loss impairs cytoplasmic calcium influx and inactivates calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase, reducing Runx2 stability and osteoblast differentiation while promoting adipogenic differentiation.

biological.citation: MiR-4649-5p acts as a tumor-suppressive microRNA in triple negative breast cancer by direct interaction with PIP5K1C (PMID: 37803350)
biological.summary: miR-4649-5p directly targets PIP5K1C in triple negative breast cancer cells. Upregulation of miR-4649-5p or downregulation/pharmacologic inhibition of PIP5K1C (with UNC3230) decreases TNBC cell growth, proliferation, and migration. PIP5K1C regulates PI3K/AKT signaling; combination of miR-4649-5p and AKT inhibitor (capivasertib) shows additive growth-reducing effects.

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - Dominant and recessive disease trait inheritance associated with variation at a single locus (J. Posey et al.)
biological.summary: Analysis of 345 trio WES cases identified 7 cases (2.0%) with de novo variants in known autosomal recessive disease genes. One case involved a de novo missense variant in PIP5K1C (associated with lethal congenital contractural syndrome 3, MIM #611369) in a conserved protein region with predicted damaging effect, suggesting single heterozygous variant may cause phenotype.
